questions.question: If interest is being compounded half yearly and rate of interest is 20 percent per annum, then in how much time Rs. 15000 will become Rs. 19965 at compound interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Interest is being compounded half yearly and rate of interest is 20 percent per annum.

**Formula used:**

In compound interest,

Amount = Principal × (1 + r / 100)n

Calculation:

Let, n is the number of terms

The rate of interest is 20 /2 = 10%

As per the question,

⇒ 19965 = 15000(1 + 10/100)ⁿ .

⇒ 19965/15000 = (1 + 1/10)ⁿ.

⇒ 19965/15000 = (1 + 1/10)n.

⇒ 1331/1000 = ( 11/10)n.

⇒ (11 /10)³ = (11/10)n.

⇒ n = 3

So the actual time is 3 / 2 years = 18 months

**∴ The correct option is** 2

questions.question: If 80 percent of total articles are sold at a loss of 25 percent and remaining articles are sold at a profit of 20 percent, then what will be the overall loss percentage?
questions.solution:
Given:

 80 percent of total articles are sold at a loss of 25 percent and remaining articles are sold at a profit of 20 percent

Concept used :

Loss is calculated on the cost price.

Calculation: 

Let total number of product is 100 and cost price of each product is Rs 10

Total cost price of 100 product is 100 × 10 = Rs 1000

So, 80 articles is sold at a loss of 25 percent

Total selling price of 80 articles is 80 × 7.50 = Rs 600

Total selling price of remaining 20 articles is 20 × 12 = Rs 240

Total loss will be,

1000 - ( 600 +240) = 160

Loss percentage is (160 /1000) × 100 = 16 %

**∴ The correct option is** 1

questions.question: Three partners P, Q and R invested a total of Rs. 52,000 in a business. At the end of the year, P got Rs. 1430, Q got Rs. 1870 and R got Rs. 2420 as the share of profit. How much amount did Q invest in the business?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Profit Ratio P : Q : R = 1430 : 1870 : 2420 = 13 : 17 : 22.

Total Profit units = 13 + 17 + 22 = 52 units.

Since time is constant, Investment Ratio = Profit Ratio.

52 units = Rs. 52,000 ⇒ 1 unit = Rs. 1,000.

Q investment = 17 units × 1,000 = Rs. 17,000.

**∴ The correct option is C.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total investment = Rs. 52,000

Profit of P = Rs. 1430, Profit of Q = Rs. 1870, Profit of R = Rs. 2420

**Formula Used:**

Investment Ratio = Profit Ratio (When time period of investment is same for all partners)

 Profit Ratio Analysis
 
 P: 13u
 
 Q: 17u
 
 R: 22u
 
• 
 Total Units = 52 = Rs. 52,000

**Calculations:**

Profit Ratio P : Q : R = 1430 : 1870 : 2420

⇒ P : Q : R = 143 : 187 : 242 (Dividing by 10)

⇒ P : Q : R = 13 : 17 : 22 (Dividing by 11)

Sum of ratio parts = 13 + 17 + 22 = 52

⇒ Q’s Investment = (17 / 52) × 52000

⇒ Q’s Investment = 17 × 1000

⇒ Q’s Investment = Rs. 17,000

**∴ The correct option is C.**

**__Additional Information__**

Simple Partnership

When investments are for the same duration, Profit₁ : Profit₂ = Capital₁ : Capital₂.

Compound Partnership

When investments are for different durations, Profit Ratio = (C₁ × T₁) : (C₂ × T₂), where C is capital and T is time.

Calculating Capital

Capital = Profit ÷ Time. If profit ratio and time ratio are known, the capital ratio can be derived directly.</p

questions.question: The speed of a boat in upstream is 8 km/hr and the speed of stream is 4 km/hr. The boat covers a distance of x km in upstream and x km in downstream. If the total time taken by the boat is 9 hours, then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Given:

The speed of a boat in upstream is 8 km/hr and the speed of stream is 4 km/hr.

The boat covers a distance of x km in upstream and x km in downstream.

The total time taken by the boat is 9 hours

Concept used:

Downstream speed = Boat speed + speed of the current

Distance = speed × time

Upstream speed = Boat speed - speed of the current

Calculation:

Upstream speed = 8 km/hr

So the speed of the boat in still water = Upstream speed + speed of the stream

So

⇒ The speed of the boat in still water 8 + 4 = 12 km/hr

Speed of boat in downstream will be 

⇒ 12 + 4 = 16 km

So, the time taken will be 

⇒ x / 8 + x / 16 = 9

⇒ 3x / 16 = 9

⇒ x = 48km

∴ The correct option is 1
